usg.text: Xantcha, a Phyrexian outcast who rebelled against her makers, guided Urza and warned him that Phyrexians in human skin were everywhere as sleeper agents, while Urza thought he was on a crusade and she knew it was a robbery.
She defied Gix, telling him he would never control her, though a priest cast her to the ground and called for her to be scrapped.
Urza and Xantcha traveled to Equilor seeking the origin of the Phyrexians, and later assaulted Phyrexia together, blasting a hole to the Fourth Sphere before Yawgmoth drove them off.

At Koilos she read Thran glyphs and learned that the Thran and Phyrexians share origins, then she and Ratepe sacrificed themselves by reaching into Gix's beam, which let Urza defeat Gix, and Urza made Karn by implanting her heartstone in a silver golem.
